name: privacy-manifest-check
description: Check the privacy manifests (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy) of an iOS, iPadOS or watchOS app or SDK project against the required reason API its Swift and Objective-C code calls: categories used but not declared, missing or invalid reason codes, tracking settings that disagree, incomplete collected data types. Reads files only; never runs Xcode or a build, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
